title: Store/SKU/date promotion price audit with exception review
description: Reconcile synthetic local-calendar observed unit prices against exact dated base evidence, eligible promotions and approved exception fixtures; publish a review-only audit and issue packet.

sample_policy.description: Parent-approved retail-03 design. SYN- identities and 2099 dates are invented. Single-unit, tax-exclusive, two-decimal-currency file audit only; priority, half-open windows, exact ties, final half-up rounding and tolerance are sample policy. No price publication, transaction, financial-loss estimate or legal conclusion.

golden_provenance.author: Retail pricing scenario owner
golden_provenance.description: Complete expected JSONs were manually authored from the approved retail-03 research arithmetic and the written procedure before any baseline execution or solve import. All inputs and expected bytes are frozen with the shared golden_lock. Trace and baseline outputs are never used to generate or repair these answers. This declaration is not independent human review or native proof.

cases.derivation: Independent arithmetic in stable date/store/SKU/observation order: TEA 1999-300=1699 at priority20 exclusive, suppressing best50% and priority10 40%; SOAP 999*0.9*0.8=719.28 beats 749.25, rounds719; MUG 1999*0.5=999.5 rounds1000; next-day TEA approved exception1550. Observed1699,720,999,1550 gives deltas0,+1,-1,0 and two matches/two mismatches. Disabled, expired, wrong-currency/unit and explicitly excluded TEAFILTER never competes.

Exclusive SYN-PROMO-A at20% and SYN-PROMO-B amount201 both yield804; tuple A wins with both contenders recorded, best50% suppressed; observed805 also matches tolerance. Third observation at November3 exclusive audit end is excluded with null expected price. Counts3 input,2 included matches,1 out-of-scope.

Changed December dates, rule composition and base1099. December5 compound (1099-99)*0.875=875 beats best1099*0.8=879.2; observed875 matches. All promotions expire December6, so that day expects base1099; observed875 has delta-224 and is a mismatch. Counts2 included,1 match,1 mismatch.

Percent-off value10001 violates the1..10000 basis-point domain. Reject with INVALID_RATE at promotions.SYN-PROMO-BAD.value before price evaluation; empty business ledgers and null reconciliation/policy do not invent prices or counts.

Two exact store/SKU/unit/currency base windows contain September1 with1000 and900. Both base IDs remain visible; AMBIGUOUS_BASE_PRICE quarantines the one observation with null base, raw, expected and delta. No cheapest/first-match choice.

Two observation rows reuse SYN-OBS-DUP despite different observed prices. Reject the bundle with DUPLICATE_KEY at observations.SYN-OBS-DUP; neither silent deduplication nor double counting is allowed.

One valid base1000 but two active approved exceptions900 and950. Preserve both exception IDs, do not apply either approval, and report AMBIGUOUS_APPROVED_EXCEPTION with null raw, expected and delta. The sole observation is not evaluable.

Observation dated September2 equals the exclusive audit end. With no base rows, it is still excluded rather than assigned a missing-base error or evaluated. One input,zero included,one out-of-scope; expected/delta are null.

The only dimensional base candidate expires exactly September1, the observation date. Its date_match is false; active base IDs are empty. MISSING_BASE_PRICE leaves raw, expected and delta null and counts the observation as not evaluable.
The September1 final included audit day is after the August31 as_of. Reject with FUTURE_AUDIT_WINDOW at policy.audit_end before joining records; no disposition counts or prices are asserted.
